answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 39622 Country: Bangladesh Title: My father is an illiterate person. He has some wrong believes about Islam Question: My father is an illiterate person. He has some wrong believes about Islam. He is not so careful about Shariah. My father does know how to read the holy Quran. He contains the marifat line like some abnormal activities. He does chodropara (pir-murid). It is not legal in Shariah. I cannot make him understand. So what can I do now? Answer ID: 39622 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 500/524/N=1433) You should contact an authentic and reliable Alim of your area with whom your father has some attachment, and tell him the situation of your father, then that Alim should make your father understand the true religion in good manner and with wisdom and try to bring him on right path. Also you too should do duas for you father and also ask the pious and elder persons to make dua for him. In-shaAllah, your father shall receive guidance. May Allah guide all of us! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
